messages:
infra-oncall: noticed spike in `gpu-autoscaler` errors in ap-southeast-2 after the org-wide VPC tag enforcement rollout at ~12:05 UTC. nodes aren't being created, pods pending. logs show CreateTags AccessDenied.

kevin: can you paste the error? is this the new policy that enforces `tag:cost-center` + `tag:owner` on resources?

infra-oncall: yep. sample error: 
```
Error: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
caused by: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/gpu-autoscaler-role is not authorized to perform: ec2:CreateTags on resource: arn:aws:ec2:ap-southeast-2:... because of condition on kms:EncryptionContext or tag:owner requirement
```

maria: wait, why is KMS in the condition? the tag policy added a requirement that tags must be encrypted with the org CMK for auditability. that means whoever tags instances needs kms:Encrypt for the CMK. autoscaler role probably lacks that.

sam: if autoscaler can't tag, ASG/nodegroup provisioning fails since our bootstrap depends on tags to attach SGs and routing policies. this would block new GPU nodes.

jess: rolling back the tag-enforcement SCP/policy is an option but will revert audit guarantees. can we instead give the autoscaler role temporary kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt on the org CMK?

kevin: quick mitigation plan: 1) grant kms:Encrypt to `gpu-autoscaler-role` on CMK (short-lived) 2) run backfill job to tag existing nodes 3) re-run autoscaler to allow new nodes 4) audit and tighten after.

infra-oncall: agree. also firewall/NACL tweak earlier blocked instance metadata calls in one AZ, that made bootstrap flaky — noticed `169.254.169.254` timeouts on some nodes while attempting to retrieve tags. two separate issues compounded the outage.

maria: created a fast PR to add kms:Encrypt permission to autoscaler role with expiration tag on the role. filing as hotfix: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4823 (WIP).

deploy-bot: hotfix pr created by @maria. CI checks pending. :white_check_mark:

kevin: i'll approve if we add a followup ticket to remove perm after migration and to instrument a CloudWatch alarm for TagResource failures (metric: `CreateTagsErrors` from autoscaler logs).

jess: also need to update onboarding doc for dedicated GPU pools: autoscaler role must have kms:Encrypt on org CMK and ec2:CreateTags. add to terraform module.

sec-team-bot: flagged. creating compliance ticket COMPL-2026-117: need to document why this exception exists and schedule rotation review for CMK access.

infra-oncall: immediate actions executed: granted kms:Encrypt scoped to CMK for autoscaler role (temporary), restarted autoscaler controller, increased dedicated pool by +4 GPU nodes manually to reduce user impact. capacity is recovering. monitoring port-forwarding on pending pods.

sam: followups: (1) schedule a controlled rollout of tag policy with a canary account to test autoscaler interactions, (2) add unit test to infra CI to simulate missing tag perms, (3) run a backfill job to ensure all nodegroups have required tags within 1 hour.

kevin: owner for backfill + cleanup = @sam, deadline EOD UTC. owner for compliance writeup = @maria.

infra-oncall: will keep thread updated. logging note: we should also surface this as a brief incident postmortem since customer-facing latency spikes happened. anyone object?

jess: no objection. keep it brief and include exact ACLs/permissions changed. :+1:

infra-oncall: thanks all. monitoring shows nodes healthy in ap-southeast-2, pending pods draining. will update COMPL ticket when clean-up perms are revoked.

sec-team-bot: COMPL-2026-117 updated with mitigation steps and timeline.

kevin: good catch. major lesson: tagging + KMS gating needs to be validated against infra automation flows before org-wide enforcement.

infra-oncall: closing slack thread for now — will reopen if we see regressions.
